name: AccountHierarchy
title: Blocks/Account/AccountHierarchy
summary: The account hierarchy: organizations, groups and workspaces in one `Table` with tree rows (`get-sub-rows`, `v-model:expanded`, a treegrid with the row-focus keyboard map) and row selection. A `PageHeader` with Create Workspace, a search `Input` over name, ID, type and labels that keeps the ancestors of each match (a small `EmptyState` with Clear search when nothing matches), the paginated tree, an action row with Create Group, the bulk Move, Labels and Delete that act on the selection, Refresh and Hide details, and a details panel with Permissions (role bindings of the one selected resource as `KeyValueList`) and Labels tabs. Move picks a new parent in a `Dialog` (never the resource itself or anything inside it); Labels adds and removes labels on every selected resource; Delete counts what is inside in a `ConfirmDialog` and keeps it in Resources pending deletion for 30 days; each ends in a toast, Move and Delete with Undo. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot.

variants.name: Selected
variants.summary: One workspace selected: the bulk actions are enabled, Clear selection shows, and the details panel lists its role bindings and labels.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No resource yet: a flush EmptyState with Create workspace replaces the table; the toolbar stays with the bulk actions disabled.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the table's loading rows under its headers.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The hierarchy did not load: a danger Alert with Retry replaces the table; Retry loads it.
